# ma-borne-electrique.com

> Electric vehicle charging station locator with a live worldwide map and a practical guide to charging connectors (Type 2, CCS, CHAdeMO). Available in French, English, German, and Spanish.

Station data comes from Open Charge Map (openchargemap.org), an open, collaborative database. Map tiles are provided by OpenStreetMap contributors.

## Languages

- French (default): https://ma-borne-electrique.com/fr
- English: https://ma-borne-electrique.com/en
- German: https://ma-borne-electrique.com/de
- Spanish: https://ma-borne-electrique.com/es

## Main pages (French URLs shown; replace /fr with /en, /de, or /es)

- [Home and world map](https://ma-borne-electrique.com/fr): search and map of charging stations anywhere in the world.
- [Connector guide](https://ma-borne-electrique.com/fr/blog/types-de-bornes-electriques): explains Type 2, Combo CCS, and CHAdeMO standards, power output, and charging times.
- [About](https://ma-borne-electrique.com/fr/a-propos): project background and data sources.
